dependence_model.name: full_positive_rank_dependence_no_diversification_credit
dependence_model.definition: For every included workload component i, X_i=Q_i(U), where one U distributed Uniform(0,1) is shared globally and every Q_i is a nondecreasing generalized-inverse marginal quantile function.
dependence_model.reviewer_effort_coupling: Reviewer-effort P50 entries use the same shared-rank planning assumption; only their additive P50 is reported.

interpretation: At the declared ranks, additive quantiles are mathematically exact only under the stated comonotonic construction.
Full positive rank dependence gives no diversification credit; it is a planning assumption, not a distribution-free bound or a claim that reality is maximally dependent.
Two elicited ranks do not identify a complete marginal distribution, confidence interval, or probability of meeting a calendar date.
Stable-core and optional-profile partitions are reported separately before the full-portfolio sum.
Elapsed waits remain separate and cannot be added to person-hours.
